about: Trigger-entry one trip: how candidates are picked for the pools a trigger moved. Checked by BOTH the sidecar (sim/tests/trig_entry.rs, check/entry.rs select) and the bot (src/test/trigSpeed.test.ts, execution/trigEntry.ts rankRoutes), so the two can never drift apart. Rows per pool are in the bot's route order; h = start coin we hold; s = quick price score (null = unknown); e = entry id (null = the bot could not build it).

cases.name: one pool, two directions, better score first
a coin we hold beats a better score; unknown score last; cap counts unbuildable rows
ties keep the order the moved pools were named in
equal scores: route order; negative scores still beat unknown
unknown pool and no routes: nothing
pool keys are matched without case
